title: New session page repeats 'Sessions' as a back link right under the marked Sessions tab
what_happens: The bar shows 'Sessions' as the current tab, and 4 lines below the page shows '← Sessions' above 'New session'. Two links to the same place, one above the other.
who_hurts: Small: extra noise at the top of the create page.
suggested_fix: Drop the '← Sessions' link in src/app/admin/new/page.tsx:16 (the tab already goes back), or keep it and stop marking the tab current there.
rule: Dane's UI rules: 'Be careful about redundant titles, headings and nav entries. Consolidate where possible to avoid repeating the same thing twice on one screen.'
